requirements.description: Next.js App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind v4 project runs locally with `pnpm dev` and produces a Chinese placeholder home: title Atoms Studio — 可验证的 AI 应用生成.

OpenNext Cloudflare adapter configured (`next.config.ts` calls `initOpenNextCloudflareForDev`, `open-next.config.ts`, `wrangler.jsonc` name `atoms-demo`, placement `aws:us-east-1`, custom-domain route `atoms.maoxunxing.com`, D1 binding `DB`)

Drizzle schema + repository interface for D1 tables: `projects`, `messages`, `runs`, `agent_events`, `versions`, `usage`. Local Next.js / Vitest / Playwright use better-sqlite3 (or libsql) behind the same interface; Workers use the D1 binding.
Anonymous `deviceId` cookie issued on first visit (HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, long-lived); all project/run/usage rows are scoped by it.
LLM provider abstraction with modes `gemini` | `mock` | `replay`, selected by `LLM_PROVIDER`. `mock` is deterministic for tests; `replay` auto-fallback is labelled clearly when activated.
Rate limits: per-`deviceId` daily run cap (`DEVICE_DAILY_RUN_LIMIT`) and global daily token cap (`DAILY_TOKEN_CAP`); over-cap paths degrade to `replay` (or refuse with a clear Chinese message).
Env documented in `.env.example` (`GEMINI_API_KEY`, `LLM_PROVIDER`, `DAILY_TOKEN_CAP`, `DEVICE_DAILY_RUN_LIMIT`). Secrets never committed.
Verify gates green: `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:e2e` (with `LLM_PROVIDER=mock`), `pnpm build`. `fh verify` records all five check ids.
